data.sql: SELECT commerce.inventory.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, commerce.inventory.product_id AS product_id, commerce.products.product_name AS product_name, commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand AS stock_on_hand FROM commerce.inventory JOIN commerce.products ON inventory.product_id = products.product_id WHERE commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $1 ORDER BY commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand DESC NULLS LAST, commerce.inventory.snapshot_date, commerce.inventory.product_id, commerce.products.product_name LIMIT 20
